expectations.text: Lists melatonin-containing foods (e.g. tart cherry, eggs, fish, milk, oats, grapes, pomegranates, walnuts) and/or tryptophan with carbohydrates for sleep
expectations.evidence: melatonin foods incl. tart cherry; tryptophan with carbs

expectations.text: Mentions chamomile tea and omega-3 fatty fish for sleep
For fatigue, recommends anti-inflammatory foods/polyphenols, magnesium and zinc, B vitamins, and capsaicin-rich chili peppers
expectations.evidence: anti-inflammatory, magnesium/zinc, B vitamins, capsaicin chili peppers

expectations.text: Advises keeping caffeine under 400 mg/day and no caffeine after 3 p.m.
Notes that alcohol may help you fall asleep but disrupts sleep
Explains the circadian rhythm / gut bacteria connection and how night shifts or jet lag disrupt it
expectations.evidence: gut bacteria daily cycles disrupted by jet lag/night shifts
